scenes.say: Tomorrow morning, the branch meets. This is the first meeting the Builder runs.
Before you sleep tonight, go to Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash meetings. Type your agent number. There is no password.
Read tomorrow's agenda, and put your item on it. It goes on before anybody sits down.
At half past eight, a button appears that says I am here. Press it. That one is the register.
We begin at nine o'clock. The screen carries the numbers, so only the exceptions are spoken.
Production. The call list. Maturities. The campaign. What we promised last week, and what came back.
Then the room has it. An agent shows what worked. One of us teaches. The floor is open.
Each unit closes with its own number. That is what next week opens on.
Afterwards, the minutes. Every action carries a name.
